comments.body: 50 or more wins can unlock the title however 10~13 wins of Orange(or Red) should be included. I forgot the exact number but at least 10 wins of Orange color are needed.

wiki:
Title acquisition requirements:
- Defeat 10 Orange or Red Ganadors
AND
- Total number of any Ganadors you have defeated reaches 50
